notes.title: Update Announcement on June 4
notes.content:
**Experience Optimization (Story Mode Type, Controller Vibration, Combat Class Tuning, Overall Optimization):**
※  A new controller vibration feature has been added to optimize impact feedback. Currently, it is integrated with two weapons: the Mo Dao and the Leg Blade. The intensity of the vibration can be adjusted and turned off in the settings panel according to personal preference. Over the next two days, we will add vibration feedback for the War Drum and optimize the vibration experience for the Mo Dao and Leg Blade based on player feedback.
※  A new combat difficulty option has been added in the settings, allowing players to switch at any time. After switching, the "Phantom Walk" difficulty will significantly increase initial attributes to help new players become familiar with the game.
※ A new story frequency option is now available in the settings, allowing for easy switching. After switching, the chance of encountering "Remembrance" doubles, enabling players who prefer the storyline to collect content more quickly.
※  The generation of spirits from certain spikes has been optimized to occur beneath the most recent enemy target.
※  Optimized the performance of the Qiantang Dragon Lord under Weapon 2, with randomly generated drums prioritizing throws towards the nearest enemy target.
※  When players of the Water Element cast the Celestial Soul skill, the Celestial Soul skill will also be duplicated.
※  Optimized Li Jing so that summoning treasures no longer requires the consumption of spirit.
※  Added a cutscene to mark the beginning of Chapter 3.
※  In the Remembrance where fireworks are exchanged for the Mo Dao, the required number of fireworks has been changed from 30 to 10.
※  The reward room for the three-choice bonus has been changed to allow the selection of relics. (This optimization for relics is temporary for today; in the future, we will allow multiple selections for relics to give players more choices, and we will also optimize the display of relics to make obtaining and viewing them clearer).

**Bug Fixes:**
※  Fixed an issue where the calculations for lunar phases and remembrance refreshing could become disordered under special circumstances.
※  Fixed a sporadic issue where room rewards would not refresh.
※  Fixed a combat freeze issue that occurred after a wood-type build was established.
※  Corrected an issue where the poison mist from the poison class appeared to float in the air.

※ Patched edge cases where rewards/enemies could spawn outside playable areas.

notes.title: May 27 Daily Update (Continuous daily updates in progress)
notes.content:
【Experience Optimizations】
● Adjusted Soul release logic to reduce formation randomness, helping players experience build completion more consistently
● Enhanced stage performance: Added skip button for viewed cutscenes. Reduced lunar phase interruptions by 50% to maintain combat flow (Special thanks to community member Sanren)
● Reduced HP for specific enemies and adjusted post-shield-break health values to improve combat pacing
● Increased AOE damage during executions for better visceral feedback, with minor improvements for clearing residual enemies (Continuous execution fatigue solutions in development)
● Controller optimization: Adjusted right stick vertical sensitivity & enabled scrolling preview without direct hover focus
● Refined lunar phase effects based on community feedback - reduced eye strain while preserving visual identity
● Increased Ling drops from enemies with corresponding merchant price adjustments
● Balanced divination costs at Chongniang to prevent infinite farming exploits
● Synchronized Po refresh costs with Ling drop rates to maintain combat equilibrium
● Improved visual feedback for selected slots in save interface

● Resolved enemy invisibility bug caused by Leg Blade execution hits
● Fixed enemy clones spawning outside playable areas

● Adjusted Gao Xianzhi's grab mechanics and synchronized skill hitboxes with VFX timing (Thanks to streamer Nvliu66)
● Patched relic duplication exploit through reloading in preparation rooms
● Fixed inactive golden trait issue on Thorn: Endless Darkness
● Corrected text errors in Mystic Codex reward descriptions
● Removed deprecated magic array effects and obsolete rune descriptions
● Standardized bracket usage in Water Soul descriptions
● Fixed attack frequency reduction when using Qiantang Dragon Lord with Leg Blade
● Resolved peach count overflow issue
● Fixed framerate setting conflict with V-Sync activation

notes.title: 5月27日游戏更新说明
notes.content:
各位殿下们晚上好，今天的开发组依然在紧锣密鼓的优化游戏！你们的意见我们都有听到！

这就为大家送上今日份更新：

体验优化： 

1.删除月相更新影响战斗感受的黑白效果。

 2.修改蛾眉殇答题文本，增加提示性文字，并在过程loading中增加部分答案。 

3. 修改月相提示，在扣血前都能知道本次是月相的玩法类型。 

4. 修改选武器时选项的顺序。 

5.优化追忆开始前的黑屏字幕重复且不可跳过的问题。 

6.新增受击/相机抖动开启关闭的接口，头晕的玩家有福音了。 

7.魄投放流派升级，增加随机规则保护，更容易出现自己想要升级的魄。 

8.优化异闻录投放魄的体验，让大家更容易拿到。

 9.部分灵掉落物的延时进包时间太久，加快进包时间。 

10.优化带鱼屏显示。 

11.优化背包临时道具的动态时限显示，现在可以显示效果可以持续多少个房间。

 12..优化过关统计显示。

 

Bug修复： 

1.错过二三难度领取难度首通供品奖励的家人们，上线后会补发没拾取的供品。 

2.修复部分玩家多结局异闻录投放丢失的Bug。 

3.帧率设置失效修复，可以设置120帧生效了。 

4.修复在挑战房因刷茧拿奖励，而导致无法进入下一关的bug。 

5.局内返回大厅增加手动确定，避免误操作离开。 

6.修改问心、选项、戏台等文字显示和阅读跳过bug。 

7.将灵龛神位中八仙名称规则一致。 

8.探报被暂停关闭问题修复。 

9.三选一界面去掉被误打开的关闭按钮。 

10.修正水月冲刺羁绊和描述不符的问题。 

11.修复技能图标初始化的Bug。 

12.修复部分魄的投放配置里配置了多个重复一样的Buff的Bug。 

13.修复蓄力技能施法时动作错误的Bug。 

14.修复金系和土系魂的供品的描述的Bug。

以上为本次更新的全部内容，如果殿下们在游戏过程中还有发现其他问题，欢迎随时在社区或其他地方向我们反馈，我们将马不停蹄的完成修复！

notes.title: Patch Notes for May 25, 2025
notes.content:
1.Fixed an issue where picking up peaches would not immediately trigger their effects. Thank you to Xin Suifeng Shirenushui for reporting the bug.
2.Fixed a crash that occurred when General Gao Xianzhi executed the player in the final stage. Thank you to the enthusiastic members of the QQ group for their feedback.
3.Added mouse/keyboard hover tooltips to the Sense Selection Interface and optimized the wording of the tips. Thank you to SanRen for the suggestion during the livestream.
4.Fixed a bug related to experience gain mechanics. Thank you to Wuchang Go for identifying the issue.
5.Changed the third stage portal to require active player input for teleportation. Thank you to the user who provided feedback on the Steam comments section.
6.Fixed a bug with the Water Moon skill: during the third boss fight, if the Water Moon rings were teleported multiple times, the game would freeze at 1 frame. Thank you to Alone for reporting this via Steam comments.
7.Fixed a crash that occurred after completing the second difficulty level with full stars, selecting offerings, and using the Haijing artifact. Thank you to Dao of the Indescribable for the report.

notes.title: 4月23日更新公告
notes.content:
各位殿下好！

首先感谢各位殿下和主播的热情支持和互动，在全新试玩demo上线1天之后，开发组针对殿下们的反馈进行了一波修复，现在汇报一下具体更新内容：

1. 修复存在城墙时，怪物可能呆住的问题 ；
2. 修复融魂触发概率失效，导致必然触发城墙/水相/溺水机制的问题 ；
3. 修复被“金戈”标记的怪物，受陷阱伤害增加未生效问题 ；
4. 修复120帧下，长按跳过动画与长按龟壳生成卦象所需时间与进度条不匹配问题 ；
5. 修复魄三选一界面可能存在空选项问题 ；
6. 修复探报界面，概率无法选择选项问题 ；
7. 修复房间入口表现问题 ；
8. 修复部分界面多语言表现问题 ；

以上为本次更新的全部内容，如果殿下们在试玩过程中还有发现其他问题，欢迎随时在社区或其他地方向我们反馈，我们将马不停蹄的完成修复！期待本次更新能给大家带来更好的游戏体验。
